name: Summon: Yojimbo
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I — Exile target artifact, enchantment, or tapped creature an opponent controls.
II, III — Until your next turn, creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each of those creatures.
IV — Create X Treasure tokens, where X is the number of opponents who control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Vigilance
blocked_sentences: II, III — Until your next turn, creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each of those creatures.

needs.what: a one-shot effect (usable from a chapter ability) that creates a player-scoped attack tax — creatures can't attack the effect's controller unless their controller pays a mana cost per attacker — lasting until the controller's next turn and independent of the source staying on the battlefield; the timed twin of the attack_tax static, read by player_statics.attack_tax at declare-attackers
needs.why_existing_wont_do: attack_tax exists only as a static_effect, read from battlefield statics while the source is present, with no duration; the cant_attack_player op takes until_your_next_turn but is an absolute prohibition with no price (a lock, strictly stronger than the printed tax); grant_ability (op) only grants triggered/activated abilities and has only until_end_of_turn or permanent durations, so it can't hand the Saga a timed static, and a static on the Saga would also end if the Saga left early
